title: Vortrag: Quantum Computers Meet Artifical Intelligence (auf Englisch)
description: in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Karlsruher Institut für Technologie, KIT-Zentrum Elementarteilchen- und Astroteilchenphysik (In englischer Sprache) Eintritt frei Join us for an engaging evening exploring the exciting world where quantum computers and artificial intelligence collide. Quantum computers are a brand-new kind of machine that use the strange and powerful rules of quantum physics to solve problems much faster than traditional computers. Imagine a computer that uses the strange laws of quantum mechanics, in which the classical bit values one and zero become a continuum of possibilities – this is what quantum computers can do! But how do they work with AI? Artificial intelligence helps machines learn and make decisions, while quantum computers could supercharge this process, making AI even smarter and more efficient. Together, they open up thrilling possibilities for the future, from applications in particle physics and medical breakthroughs to smarter technologies in our daily lives. This event will break down these complex ideas into simple, easy-to-understand concepts. You’ll hear how quantum computing and AI are evolving, the challenges they face, and why they matter for all of us. Come discover how these innovations could shape the world of tomorrow!
